category_taxonomy.name: ESA Indico site Category tree
category_taxonomy.versioning: No public taxonomy version or release manifest; 3.3.12 is the observed Indico software release, not a vocabulary version.
category_taxonomy.governance: Category titles, parent links, order, and protection are site content managed by authorized category administrators/managers. Event and contribution classification values are entered by event managers; the public interface exposes no governance roster.
category_taxonomy.update_cadence: No public cadence is specified; changes are administrative/content changes rather than scheduled vocabulary releases.
category_taxonomy.preferred_terms: None published. Category titles, keywords, labels, tracks, and contribution types have no preferred-term relation.
category_taxonomy.synonyms: None published or exposed by the public endpoints.

hierarchy.live_notes: The 2026-08-27 public /category/0/info response listed direct children 6, 7, and 5; 9 was a child of 6. /category/0/ redirected to /.

identity.id_field: integer Category.id and URL path segment
identity.stability: Installation-local record locator only. IDs are not a portable vocabulary key; titles and parent paths can change, and deleted categories are not valid current terms.
identity.root_exception: ID 0 is the synthetic/root Home category; its canonical browse URL is /, although /category/0/info is a public hierarchy endpoint.

category.scope_notes: description is free-form category content; there is no separate controlled scope-note field

event_keywords.surface: public event HTML meta keywords and HTTP event/category export keywords
event_keywords.preferred_or_synonym_behavior: none; optional allowed-keyword configuration is case-insensitively deduplicated but does not create synonyms
event_keywords.subject_search: not indexed by current unqualified event search

event_type.export_alias: simple_event is the category-export alias for lecture
event_type.ids: source enum values are format identifiers, not subject IDs; public query syntax uses names
event_type.meaning: event format/feature type, not a subject taxonomy

event_label.surface: optional classification label in event management/export
event_label.value_type: instance-wide label title/color/message; no subject hierarchy
event_label.ids: not included in the public event export label object
event_label.subject_search: not a current search target or facet

contribution_keywords.surface: HTTP event export contribution keywords when present
contribution_keywords.preferred_or_synonym_behavior: none published; optional allowed list state is not public
contribution_keywords.subject_search: not indexed by current contribution search

contribution_type.public_export: contribution type is a name or null; the numeric ID and private definitions are not exposed by the public export
contribution_type.preferred_or_synonym_behavior: none; names are unique case-insensitively within one event only
contribution_type.subject_search: not indexed and no global facet exists

contribution_track.public_export: track is a display string; track/group IDs are not included
contribution_track.preferred_or_synonym_behavior: none published; tracks are event-program organization
contribution_track.subject_search: not indexed and no global facet exists

scope_notes.browse_default: A category page lists direct child categories and direct events. A flat subtree view is configuration-dependent and only applies when enabled; it is not a taxonomy expansion control.
scope_notes.category_search: category_id=C scopes event/contribution/material/note searches to C and descendants, but category-result searches to descendants excluding C itself. category_id=0 is treated as the root/global scope by current InternalSearch.
scope_notes.category_export: GET /export/categ/C.json includes events whose category chain contains C or a descendant; hyphen-separated category IDs are supported by the official export API. Date, access, and export filters affect returned counts.
scope_notes.no_expansion_controls: There is no public explosion, focus, major-topic, preferred-term, or synonym switch.

browse_vs_search_facet.browse: The category pages and /info endpoint are the hierarchy/browse interface.
browse_vs_search_facet.search_result_group: Categories is one global-search result group; it is not a subject facet.
browse_vs_search_facet.search_facet: No category, keyword, track, contribution-type, or event-label facet is exposed. The live /search/api/options response was {placeholders: [], sort_options: []}.

scope_syntax.category_target: type=category searches category titles; category_id is scope, not a category term

expansion.search_event_like_targets: implicit subtree expansion via Event.category_chain_overlaps; no caller toggle

subject_restriction_judgment.reason: The public Category tree is a site navigation/ownership hierarchy, while keywords, labels, tracks, and contribution types are free-form or event-local. There is no published subject scope-note policy, synonym/preferred-term service, version, cadence, public term-ID vocabulary, or search facet. Category IDs are safe only as explicitly validated organizational scope, not as inferred subjects.

typed_scope_interface.validation: category_id is checked by the visible category-search route; category_path, when supplied, must exactly match the visible root-to-leaf ID path
typed_scope_interface.search_scope: the category-search route sends category_id to every selected result-group request; event/contribution/material/note results include the selected category and descendants, while category results include descendants only
typed_scope_interface.export_scope: the public category exporter includes the selected category and descendants; the rendered adapter records this capability but does not substitute native export data for search results
typed_scope_interface.subject_boundary: category IDs and paths are organizational scope only; no keyword, label, contribution-type, or track filter is exposed

known_item_effects.name: category_scope_expands_events_to_descendants
known_item_effects.source_effect: category_id uses Event.category_chain_overlaps and includes the selected category and its subtree

known_item_effects.name: category_target_scope_is_descendants_only

observations.category_id_9: explicit empty result (the category itself is excluded)

known_item_effects.source_effect: category search uses Category.deep_children_query, which excludes the selected category itself

known_item_effects.name: category_export_scope_expands_to_descendants
known_item_effects.source_effect: the HTTP category exporter filters Event.category_chain_overlaps(idlist)

known_item_effects.name: event_keyword_is_not_unqualified_event_search
known_item_effects.source_effect: event search uses Event.title_matches(q), not Event.keywords

known_item_effects.name: event_type_is_an_export_filter_not_a_subject_facet
known_item_effects.source_effect: type is a category-export filter for lecture/simple_event, meeting, or conference

unknowns: The current instance's optional allowed event/contribution keyword lists are an administrative setting and are not publicly readable.
Private event-local contribution types, track IDs, and event-label IDs cannot be enumerated from the anonymous public hierarchy/export surfaces.
The public endpoints provide no taxonomy version, change log, or update timestamp for category/classification terms.
Export counts must not be treated as category cardinalities: the current public /category/0/info deep count and default /export/categ/0.json count have different access/filter semantics.
